newsitem.title: INDIA: India advances repayment of 10.75-pct loan.
newsitem.headline: India advances repayment of 10.75-pct loan.

text.p: The Indian government said on Monday that it will advance the repayment of the 10.75-percent loan due on October 21 by two days because of a public holiday.
It said in a statement that the loan would be repaid on October 19 because October 21 will be a holiday in some states and October 20 is a Sunday.

It said that to facilitate repayment of the loan on the due date, holders may tender the securities at the public debt offices, treasuries and sub-treasuries and branches of the State Bank of India and its associate banks, 20 days in advance.
No interest will accrue on the loan as from the due date, it said.
